run_performance_test: run a performance test for a model with configurable batch sizes, input/output lengths, and speculative decoding thresholds
run_performance_for_models: run performance tests for multiple models and write a final report with aggregate throughput metrics
create_performance_test_params: create a PerformanceTestParams dataclass with batch sizes, input/output lengths, profile directory, and speculative decoding threshold
create_performance_test_result: create a PerformanceTestResult dataclass aggregating latency, throughput, and pass/fail status across batch sizes
test_spec_accept_length: test speculative decoding accept length against a configurable threshold to validate model performance
